request.query: An algebraic element over the rationals has a nonzero natural multiple in the integral closure of the integers

items.name: IsAlgebraic.exists_integral_multiple
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Ring A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A] {z : A},
  IsAlgebraic R z → ∃ y, y ≠ 0 ∧ IsIntegral R (y • z)

items.name: IsAlgebraic.isIntegral
items.type:
∀ {K : Type u} {A : Type v} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Ring A] [inst_2 : Algebra K A] {x : A},
  IsAlgebraic K x → IsIntegral K x

items.name: mem_integralClosure_iff
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u_1) (A : Type u_2) [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A] {a : A},
  a ∈ integralClosure R A ↔ IsIntegral R a

items.name: integralClosure.isIntegral
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A]
  (x : ↥(integralClosure R A)), IsIntegral R x

items.name: integralClosure
items.type: (R : Type u_1) → (A : Type u_2) → [inst : CommRing R] → [inst_1 : CommRing A] → [inst_2 : Algebra R A] → Subalgebra R A

items.name: IsIntegralClosure.isIntegral_algebra
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u_1) {A : Type u_2} (B : Type u_3) [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : CommRing B]
  [inst_3 : Algebra R B] [inst_4 : Algebra A B] [IsIntegralClosure A R B] [inst_6 : Algebra R A] [IsScalarTower R A B],
  Algebra.IsIntegral R A

items.name: algebraicClosure.isIntegralClosure
items.type:
∀ (F : Type u_1) (E : Type u_2) [inst : Field F] [inst_1 : Field E] [inst_2 : Algebra F E],
  IsIntegralClosure (↥(algebraicClosure F E)) F E

items.name: IsIntegralClosure.isIntegral
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u_1) {A : Type u_2} (B : Type u_3) [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : CommRing B]
  [inst_3 : Algebra R B] [inst_4 : Algebra A B] [IsIntegralClosure A R B] [inst_6 : Algebra R A] [IsScalarTower R A B]
  (x : A), IsIntegral R x
